selection_rule: Latest documented runtime behavior fix in 100 current-head commits per each pre-selected feasible source; all introduced/extended offline portable regression test nodes included. Tests selected before source execution or candidate graph outputs.
preflight_exposure: All source/tests were reviewed and baseline outcomes known before candidate graph evaluation. Development/resource preflight; never relabel unseen holdout.
source_policy: Exact fixed upstream regular files only. Archive symbolic/hard links/special files are recorded and skipped; no links or build/setup scripts executed.

global_panel.selection_rule: All Test02_WithoutPackrat test methods whose upstream name contains ParseAction or TrimArity; all 23 matches kept. Expanded from original 3-method arity diagnostic before any candidate graph output; diagnostic outcomes remain known development evidence.
global_panel.known_assertion_limit: The two TrimArity exception tests only assert inside except and do not explicitly require an exception. Their passes alone cannot establish exception correctness. The variable-argument test compares actual parsed results to upstream expected sequences.

test_exclusions.reason: Requires IPython interactive-shell framework; kept out of minimal CPU preflight before execution, not based on candidate graph or assertion result.

known_limits: Assertion execution establishes behavior at fixed source versions for selected inputs. It does not establish necessary-context gold, semantic completeness, general task utility, held-out generalization, or production quality.
global_scan_limits: Only explicit function global declarations and syntactic name writes. Zero matches does not exclude global state mutation through aliases, imported modules, descriptors, attributes, mappings, or dynamic code.
